title: Recovery doesn't work as expected
author: Belphegor27
summary: Restoring a PowerToys backup onto a machine with existing Keyboard Manager mappings appends conflicting rows instead of replacing the old mapping for the same trigger.
next_action: Reproduce current backup restore with conflicting Keyboard Manager triggers and define replace-versus-merge semantics.

confidence.rationale: The historical conflict is concrete, while current semantics after subsequent rewrites remain unverified.

judgment.rationale: The report gives a concrete cross-device conflict example, but current restore semantics and behavior must be verified because the issue predates major Settings and Keyboard Manager changes.
evidence: The PC backup changes Win+O from Alt+Tab to `-`.
Restoring on the notebook leaves both old and new Win+O mappings.
The old Alt+Tab mapping remains effective, demonstrating an actionable conflict rather than display-only duplication.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce current backup restore with conflicting Keyboard Manager triggers and define replace-versus-merge semantics.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current restore behavior and the intended overwrite contract must be confirmed before choosing a merge or replacement fix.

issue_context.summary: Restoring a PowerToys backup onto a machine with existing Keyboard Manager mappings appends conflicting rows instead of replacing the old mapping for the same trigger.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.74.0.
The source and destination machines intentionally have different Keyboard Manager settings.
No maintainer response, assignee, or linked fix is present.
inferences: Restore may merge serialized remap arrays without de-duplicating by trigger or clearing destination module state first.
issue_context.analysis: A controlled round trip can establish current behavior and whether backup restore promises full replacement or selective merge.
initial_investigation: Read the complete live report and screenshot reference.
Checked live metadata and found no comments, assignee, or linked closing PR.

actions.label: Reproduce conflicting Keyboard Manager restore
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Restore a backup over an existing mapping with the same trigger
prerequisites: Current stable PowerToys on two test profiles or machines
setup: On profile A, map Win+O to `-` and create a backup.
On profile B, map Win+O to Alt+Tab and verify it works.
steps: Restore profile A's backup on profile B.
Open Keyboard Manager and record every Win+O row.
Press Win+O and record which target executes.
Restart PowerToys and verify whether the duplicate/conflict persists.
reproduce.expected_result: Restore applies a documented deterministic policy without leaving two active mappings for the same trigger; for full restore, the backed-up Win+O mapping replaces the old one.
